notes.title: RELEASE IN EARLY ACCESS AND DISCOUNT 25%.
notes.notes:
There was a release in early access, at the moment there is a 25% discount.

The game is in alpha version, so there is still a lot of work to do, but we are motivated and together with you - we will make a good game!

Tomorrow the first update will be released, in which bugs will be fixed and new exhibits will be added, new loot items will be added and much more.

P.S : In the next updates we will add Steam achievements!
